name: com.sora.unitymcp
description:
A bridge that connects AI assistants to Unity via the MCP (Model Context Protocol). Fork of CoplayDev/unity-mcp with central multi-project routing hardening: zombie-session sweeper, session-id heartbeat keepalive, hash-prefix match unification, timeout grace-period reclassification, and first-launch auto-deploy of the embedded Python server.

Allows AI clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and VSCode to directly control your Unity Editor for enhanced development workflows.
